trello.name: Renew and deploy wildcard SSL and internal CA certificates
trello.desc: Owner: Ben. Renew the wildcard SSL certificate for api.ourapp.com and the internal CA certificate that signs the service mesh, both expiring around early September. Complete renewal and deployment to load balancers by August 22nd to ensure sufficient buffer. Set up cert-manager for auto-renewal of both certificates to avoid manual renewals in the future.

trello.name: Implement PDF export feature for reports
trello.desc: Owner: Aisha. Develop the backend functionality to render reports to PDF using headless Chrome and add a frontend export button with a progress state indicating export status for large reports. Deliver the complete feature by end of the month. Additionally, record a short demo GIF of the export feature for the marketing changelog as part of the feature completion.

trello.name: Ensure staging environment schema parity with production
trello.desc: Owner: Ben. Immediately run the three pending migrations on the staging environment to bring it up to date with production. Develop and deploy a nightly job that compares the staging schema against production and posts discrepancies to the infra channel. This will help maintain staging parity and reduce QA issues caused by schema drift.
